slides.texte_overlay:
14 Life Lessons I Wish
I Knew Earlier

1. The friend who only calls
when he's bored:
Pick up less. Notice more.

2. The first paycheck:
Save some before you spend any.

3. The boss who yells:
Stay calm. Write everything down.

4. The job you hate:
Learn all you can, then leave well.

5. The family dinner you skip:
Go anyway. They won't be there forever.

6. The argument you want to win:
Ask yourself if it's worth the friend.

7. The day you feel lazy:
Do the smallest version.

8. The habit you keep breaking:
Make it two minutes long.

9. The thing you don't understand:
Look it up. Today.

10. The skill you never learned:
Start with five minutes a day.
slides.texte_sophia:
9. The thing you don't understand:
Look it up on the Sophia app. Today.

10. The skill you never learned:
Start with five minutes a day.

slides.texte_overlay:
11. The ex you still check on:
Mute. Move on.

12. The compliment you get:
Say thank you. Stop there.

13. The person who's always late:
Stop waiting. Start without them.

14. The life you want:
It's built on boring days done right.
